instruction:
Single Storey Retail Pavilion IFC

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create a Revit retail pavilion with two glazed street-facing facades and a back-of-house zone, then save the required output in the Desktop as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 4 IfcSpace entities, 5 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, and 1 IfcRoof.
5. The IFC model contains at least 3 IfcDoor entities, at least 6 IfcWindow entities, and at least 2 IfcCurtainWall entities.
6. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, and 0 IfcBeam entities.
7. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the tokens retail, storage, prep, and toilet at least once each.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding-box X span is between 16.5 m and 19.5 m.
9. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Y span is between 10.5 m and 13.5 m.
10. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Z span is between 3.3 m and 4.5 m.
11. At least one IfcCurtainWall centroid is within 1.0 m of the minimum Y edge of the shaped model bounding box.
12. At least one IfcCurtainWall centroid is within 1.0 m of the maximum X edge of the shaped model bounding box.
13. The storage, prep, and toilet IfcSpace centroids all have Y coordinates of at least 8.0 m.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.

command: if exist "C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Revit 2027\Revit.exe" (echo OK) else (echo MISSING & exit /b 1)
